events.message: Language service project build for server {server}

server.description: Validated language server session id that owns the project build

waiters.description: Number of callers waiting for the shared Java project build result

waited.description: Time spent waiting for build dispatch, encoded in milliseconds

outcome.description: Project build completion category reported by the build reducer

marker_scope.description: Diagnostic marker scope reported by the completed Java build

builder_failed_earlier.description: Whether an earlier builder failure was observed before this build completed

recovery.description: Whether the completed Java build report represents a recovery attempt

events.message: Project build waiting for server {server}: {reason}

server.description: Validated language server session id that owns the queued build

reason.description: Build dispatch blocker returned by the Java build reducer

events.message: Unused server configuration areas removed for server {server}

server.description: Validated language server session id whose configuration areas were pruned

removed.description: Number of unused language server configuration areas removed

events.message: Server configuration cleanup failed for server {server}

server.description: Validated language server session id whose configuration cleanup failed

error.description: Filesystem error raised while removing unused language server configuration areas

events.message: Language host operation failed at {stage}

server.description: Core-resolved language server identity owning this host operation

stage.description: Host operation step that failed, such as entrypoint-warmup or language-import

error.description: Native or stable runtime error that caused the host operation fallback

events.message: Maven profile application started for server {server}

server.description: Validated Java language server session id applying the Maven profiles

projects.description: Number of Java projects targeted by this Maven profile application, when known

events.message: Maven profiles applied for server {server}

server.description: Validated Java language server session id that successfully applied the Maven profiles

events.message: Maven profile application cancelled for server {server}

server.description: Validated Java language server session id whose Maven profile application was cancelled

events.message: Maven configuration updated for server {server}

server.description: Validated Java language server session id that received the Maven configuration

settings_changed.description: Whether settings changed after the Java language service was initialized

projects_reloaded.description: Whether updating the Maven configuration reloaded Java projects

profiles_updating.description: Whether a Maven profile application remains in progress after the update

events.message: Maven profiles partially applied for server {server}

server.description: Validated Java language server session id whose Maven profiles were only partially applied

events.message: Maven profile project {project} update failed for server {server} with outcome {outcome}

server.description: Validated Java language server session id updating this Maven project

project.description: Project directory derived from the Maven update project URI, redacted before persistence

outcome.description: Maven project update result, e.g. failed or timed-out

error.description: Error reported for this Maven project update or synthesized for its timeout

events.message: Maven profile project {project} update finished for server {server} with outcome {outcome}

server.description: Validated Java language server session id updating this Maven project

project.description: Project directory derived from the Maven update project URI, redacted before persistence

outcome.description: Maven project update result reported by the profile task reducer

duration.description: Elapsed time for this Maven project update in milliseconds, when available

events.message: Maven settings forwarded unchanged for server {server}: {reason}

server.description: Validated Java language server session id receiving the unchanged Maven settings

reason.description: Maven settings warning category explaining why the settings were forwarded unchanged

events.message: Pending Maven profile update failed to start for server {server}

server.description: Validated Java language server session id that could not dispatch the pending Maven update

error.description: Error returned when starting the pending Maven profile update

events.message: Maven profile application timed out for server {server}

server.description: Validated Java language server session id whose Maven profile application exceeded its deadline

events.message: Language server log message received for server {server} with severity {severity}

server.description: Validated language server session id that sent window/logMessage

diagnostic.description: Original message from the window/logMessage params, redacted and capped at 1024 UTF-8 bytes
diagnostic.reason: The language server owns the unstructured window/logMessage explanation and exposes no stable error code for it, so preserve its original wording after redaction and truncation.

severity.description: LSP MessageType mapped to a controlled severity word, e.g. error, warn, info or log

events.message: Language server show message received for server {server} with severity {severity}

server.description: Validated language server session id that sent window/showMessage

diagnostic.description: Original message from the window/showMessage params, redacted and capped at 1024 UTF-8 bytes
diagnostic.reason: The language server owns the window/showMessage explanation shown to the user; retain its original wording after redaction and truncation to correlate a reported message with the server session.

severity.description: LSP MessageType mapped to a controlled severity word, e.g. error, warn, info or log

events.message: Navigation markers served from cache for server {server} for {document}

server.description: Validated Java language server session id serving cached navigation markers

document.description: Document path derived from the navigation request URI, redacted before persistence

document_version.description: Document version used as part of the navigation marker cache key

markers.description: Number of navigation markers returned from the cache

events.message: Navigation marker batch limited for server {server} for {document}

server.description: Validated Java language server session id that limited the navigation batch

document.description: Document path for the limited navigation request, redacted before persistence

tasks.description: Number of navigation tasks requested before applying the batch limit

limit.description: Maximum navigation tasks permitted by MAX_JAVA_NAVIGATION_TASKS

events.message: Navigation marker verification failed for server {server} for {document}

server.description: Validated Java language server session id resolving the navigation marker

document.description: Document path for the marker resolution request, redacted before persistence

document_version.description: Document version associated with the marker resolution request

error.description: JSON-RPC error returned while resolving one Java navigation marker

events.message: Navigation markers resolved for server {server} for {document}

server.description: Validated Java language server session id that resolved the navigation markers

document.description: Document path for the completed navigation request, redacted before persistence

document_version.description: Document version associated with the completed navigation request

duration.description: Time from navigation request creation to marker completion, in milliseconds

tasks.description: Total navigation resolution tasks belonging to the completed request

code_lenses.description: Number of code lenses successfully resolved for the completed request

markers.description: Number of navigation markers produced by the completed request

events.message: Language server {server} notification {method} received

server.description: Validated language server session id that emitted the notification

method.description: LSP notification method name, e.g. language/status; never the notification payload

events.message: Language service process started for server {server}

server.description: Validated Java language server session id whose process started

runtime_version.description: Java runtime version used to launch the language server, when available

events.message: Language service protocol initialized for server {server}

server.description: Validated Java language server session id whose initialize handshake completed

events.message: Late language-server response ignored for server {server}

server.description: Validated language server session id that received an obsolete response

request.description: JSON-RPC response id of the late reply; absent when the response has no id

events.message: Language server shutdown timed out for server {server}

server.description: Validated language server session id whose shutdown deadline expired before termination

events.message: Language server stderr read failed for server {server}

server.description: Validated language server session id whose stderr pipe could not be read

error.description: I/O error returned by the language server stderr reader

events.message: Language server stderr received for server {server}

server.description: Validated language server session id that wrote the stderr diagnostic

diagnostic.description: Unclassified upstream stderr diagnostic; retained only for detailed diagnosis and never treated as an operation failure
diagnostic.reason: Language servers emit implementation-specific failure explanations only on stderr, so retain the original diagnostic wording for diagnosis after redaction and truncation rather than attempting an unstable parser.

truncated.description: Whether the upstream stderr line exceeded the 4096 byte reader limit

events.message: Language server trace received for server {server}

server.description: Validated language server session id that sent $/logTrace

diagnostic.description: Upstream trace summary only, redacted and capped at 1024 UTF-8 bytes; verbose RPC payloads are excluded
diagnostic.reason: Upstream trace messages describe internal protocol decisions without structured equivalents; retain their wording only during explicitly enabled detailed diagnostics.

events.message: Language service project import finished for server {server}

server.description: Validated Java language server session id that reached ServiceReady

duration.description: Elapsed workspace import time in milliseconds, when reported by the readiness diagnostics

events.message: Legacy project files removed for server {server}

server.description: Validated Java language server session id whose legacy project metadata was removed

removed_files.description: Number of legacy Java project files removed from the workspace

state_reset.description: Whether removing the legacy Java metadata also reset language server workspace state

events.message: Workspace import progress received for server {server} at {phase}

server.description: Validated Java language server session id reporting workspace import progress

phase.description: Workspace import phase reported by the Java language service

completed.description: Completed work units reported for the current import phase, when available

total.description: Total work units reported for the current import phase, when available

events.message: Workspace import progress stalled for server {server}

server.description: Validated Java language server session id still waiting for ServiceReady

duration.description: Time since the last workspace import progress observation, encoded in milliseconds

events.message: Workspace import waiting for service readiness for server {server}

server.description: Validated Java language server session id waiting for project import to reach ServiceReady

server.description: Language provider identity from the registered host provider catalog.

state.description: Core session lifecycle state emitted by the managed engine (for example ready or stopped).

stage.description: Actual source stage, such as discovery, configuration, documentSync or processStart.

exit_code.description: Native language server process exit status when supplied by the runtime.
